route_i_floor.how: Route (i) reads each identity-holding course's subject code; a code decides only when route (i) reads its holders right at least 98% of the time with at least 10 holders. For a holder the measure leaves the holder out of its own code's count.

self_recall.how: Every ordinary-title identity-holding course (its control number names one course and one M-ID's members) has its SUBJ4 predicted from the others, itself left out. support = courses that vote; share = the winner's share; a tie at the top is wrong. A route is accepted at the floors with the most predictions among those right at least 98% of the time.
